title: Typed verification result and failure taxonomy
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards; Stakeholder directive: Kotlin library first, Rust library second.

statements.label: Typed verification result and failure taxonomy
statements.requirement: A certificate failing verification SHALL produce a Failed result, not an exception or panic. Failed results SHALL name the step that failed and a reason from a closed set shared by both languages: BadPrefix, UnsupportedContextVersion, Base45Invalid, InflateFailed, LimitExceeded, CoseMalformed, HeaderInvalid, UnsupportedAlgorithm, KidNotFound, SignatureInvalid, KeyUsageMismatch, Expired, NotYetValid, HcertMissing, MultipleSubclaims, PayloadInvalid. Exceptions or errors SHALL be reserved for programming errors and infrastructure failures.
